title: JASCO: Modern CRM in three months | enCloud9
meta: How enCloud9 moved JASCO off an outdated on-premises Dynamics 365 system to Dynamics 365 Sales with over 900 automated lead assignment rules.
answer: JASCO, Inc. is an analytical instruments maker in Easton, MD that operates in 57 countries. It was held back by an outdated on-premises Dynamics 365 system. We implemented Dynamics 365 Sales with a Lead Assignment Rule Table of over 900 rules and updated form captures. In three months, sales and lead management became centralized and automated.

chapters: What was wrong with JASCO's CRM?
JASCO, Inc. makes analytical instruments, specializing in chromatography and molecular spectroscopy. It operates in 57 countries and serves manufacturers and research labs.
JASCO was struggling with an outdated on-premises Dynamics 365 system. It needed a modern CRM to improve efficiency and streamline its processes.
We implemented Dynamics 365 Sales, including a Lead Assignment Rule Table with over 900 rules, and updated JASCO's form captures.
This automated lead assignments and improved data management.
JASCO now has a centralized, automated system for sales and lead management, which has greatly improved efficiency and customer interaction.
next_steps: JASCO continues to work with us on ongoing enhancements, including potential integrations such as Adobe Sign and international lead management.
author: Kristin Caniglia
